blocks.text: ROME — Italy on Tuesday approved the deployment of 500 troops to Milan after violent clashes as fuel price protests hit pasta production and food deliveries in southern Italy. Some luxury brands have kept their shops shut in the centre of Italy’s fashion hub after looting and riots over the weekend by groups of mostly young protesters. A cabinet meeting on Tuesday also approved a series of security measures, including making the detention of minors easier and introducing the crime of “violent participation in a demonstration”.
